verdict.rationale: There is no hosted store of user data here. The installer writes the skills into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own, under an MIT license, and they work across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. Issue tracking can also live in local files, so leaving needs no export step. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of data export or uninstall/exit, clarity on what portability means for the read-only plugin-bundle install mode, and independent hands-on corroboration.
